services.desc: Join us at 4541 Queen St for Niagara Falls’ Largest Escape Room challenge. We’ve got 5 unique adventure rooms waiting for you to explore: At Adventure Rooms Canada Niagara Falls, all of our escape games are extremely fun, unrelated, and unique challenges that are not required to be completed in any order. Our adventure rooms are also of similar levels of difficulty - all of our games are created for an average 20-30% success rate. Most of our games can accommodate between 2-24 players per game - select your group size below for more information. All escape room bookings are private events for you and your guests only.
